text:
F-8zoy, source-assisted reading of the Passion-by-the-hours section (88v 14-25; checks of 86r 1-7 and 86v 1-9). Read on the images by a research reader (Claude) with Philip the Chancellor's Summa super Psalterium (Paris BnF lat. 14594 f. 29r col. a; Soissons BM 65 f. 41r col. b, page images) open, so this is source-assisted, not blind.
Conventions: (..) = expansion; ? = uncertain; [...] = lost by trimming or not read; ¶ = red paraph. Line numbers count from the top of the page, as in batch-2026-10-12b-source-assisted.

== 88v (canvas 5, f188; native box 2950,5700,4330,6850; line beginnings lost at the left) ==
14  [...]e notandum? (contra)? laicos qui horas n(on) intelligu(n)t ut loco
15  [horarum quid christus p]assus sit in singulis horis diligent(er) attendant (et) p(ro)
16  [singulis ingemisc]ant?. ¶ In hora matutinali (christus) sanguineu(m) sudore(m) su-
17  [dav]it? [... fact]us est sudor ei(us) (et)c. ¶ It(em) a iuda tradit(us) a ministris
18  [...]u(m)? captus (et) vinct(us) ab ap(osto)lis? [...] (et) tamq(uam) [...]
19  [...] paulo ant(e) dixera(n)t parati sumus tecu(m) in carcerem
20  [...]? derelictus e(st) (et) ad principes sacerdotu(m) adductus
21  [...] (et) [...] lacrimos(us)? [...] sanguis (christi)? in columpna?. Q(ui)
22  [ho]c? cogitat in corde suo (et) p(ro) singulis q(ue) passus
23  [est ...] horas matutinas deo laudabilit(er) decantauit?
24  [...]dia? nocte (et)c. ¶ In hora p(ri)ma (christus) tamq(uam) ma-
25  [lefac]tor? ductus fuit ad columpna(m) ligatus virgis cesus

Lines 17-23 were not in the earlier source-assisted record (which gave 88v 14-16 and 24-25 only). Line 18 middle, line 21 and the start of every line are insecure.

== 86r 1-7 and 86v 1-9 ==
Rechecked on the images (86r box 794,4583,2731,5233; 86v box 2582,4583,4966,5700). The image-only first reading (batch-2026-10-12b-image-only) stands, with one firmer reading: 86v 9 "ut d(icitur) in tren(is)" (first reading: "in tr(...)?"), agreeing with the witnesses' "Thren.".
